note: proxy_split: one zone's www is a proxied CNAME to its apex, whose A record is direct, so the origin address Cloudflare hides on www is published on the apex. Rows: the DNS and audit runs, the zone's two records, and every audit event on the www record (three updates on 2026-04-16: proxied off, proxied on, content re-pointed by an API token). Cut from sample/bundle.json by scripts/examples.ts; names, addresses and the actor are pseudonyms.

findings.claim: host-524b42.quest is proxied and aliases host-4c795e.quest, whose A record is direct to ip-6fb86d: the origin the proxy hides is published on the name it points at

detection.description: A proxied CNAME whose target in the same DNS run is a direct A or AAAA record: the address the proxy hides on one name is published on the other.
detection.sql:
SELECT c.zone, c.name AS proxied_name, c.record_id AS proxied_record_id, a.name AS target_name, a.type AS target_type,
       a.content AS target_content, a.record_id AS target_record_id, c.observed_at
FROM dns_record c
JOIN dns_record a ON a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.run_id = c.run_id AND a.name = c.content AND a.type IN ('A', 'AAAA') AND a.proxied = 0
WHERE c.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND c.run_id = 'run-f9470e2f5f175899' AND c.type = 'CNAME' AND c.proxied = 1
ORDER BY c.zone, c.name, c.record_id, a.record_id

checks.purpose: The collection run observed the whole population it asserted before collecting and finished complete; rows are the run failing that gate.
checks.explanation: Run run-f9470e2f5f175899 collected everything it set out to collect.
checks.sql:
SELECT c.run_id, c.tenant_id, c.surface, c.host, c.expected_count, c.observed_count, c.status
FROM collection_run c
WHERE c.run_id = 'run-f9470e2f5f175899'
  AND (c.observed_count < c.expected_count OR c.status <> 'complete'
    OR c.expected_count IS NULL OR c.observed_count IS NULL
    OR (c.surface LIKE 'linux.%' AND c.expected_count > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observation x WHERE x.run_id = c.run_id)))

checks.purpose: An audit event with a named actor touched the resource inside the window.
checks.explanation: 2 audit events with a named actor touched bce1ca2bb7caa2de9b6823d5f6ecd3f2 between 2026-04-16T21:11:15.232Z and 2026-10-24T07:58:55.125Z.
checks.sql:
SELECT event_id, source, actor, action, old_value, new_value, occurred_at
FROM audit_event
WHERE tenant_id = 'client-1' AND resource_id = 'bce1ca2bb7caa2de9b6823d5f6ecd3f2'
  AND occurred_at >= '2026-04-16T21:11:15.232Z' AND occurred_at <= '2026-10-24T07:58:55.125Z'
  AND actor IS NOT NULL AND actor <> ''
ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id

checks.purpose: The value the resource had before its latest audit event is on record: either that event carries old_value, or an earlier create or update on the same resource carries the body that was in force (Cloudflare logs no old values; the previous state is the latest earlier body).
checks.explanation: The audit log records the state bce1ca2bb7caa2de9b6823d5f6ecd3f2 had before its latest change.
checks.sql:
SELECT e.event_id, e.source, e.action, e.old_value AS previous_value, e.occurred_at AS recorded_at, 'old_value' AS evidence
FROM audit_event e
WHERE e.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND e.resource_id = 'bce1ca2bb7caa2de9b6823d5f6ecd3f2'
  AND e.old_value IS NOT NULL AND e.old_value <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event x WHERE x.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND x.resource_id = e.resource_id AND x.occurred_at > e.occurred_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.event_id, p.source, p.action, p.new_value AS previous_value, p.occurred_at AS recorded_at, 'earlier_event' AS evidence
FROM audit_event e
JOIN audit_event p ON p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND p.resource_id = e.resource_id AND p.occurred_at < e.occurred_at
  AND p.action IN ('create', 'update') AND p.new_value IS NOT NULL AND p.new_value <> ''
WHERE e.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND e.resource_id = 'bce1ca2bb7caa2de9b6823d5f6ecd3f2'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event x WHERE x.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND x.resource_id = e.resource_id AND x.occurred_at > e.occurred_at)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event y WHERE y.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND y.resource_id = e.resource_id AND y.action IN ('create', 'update')
    AND y.new_value IS NOT NULL AND y.new_value <> '' AND y.occurred_at < e.occurred_at AND y.occurred_at > p.occurred_at)
ORDER BY evidence, event_id

checks.purpose: Nothing the name resolves to changed inside the window; rows are the evidence of change, from consecutive DNS observations and from audit events on its records.
checks.explanation: host-524b42.quest changed between 2026-04-16T21:11:15.232Z and 2026-10-24T07:58:55.125Z (3 pieces of evidence).
checks.sql:
SELECT 'dns_record' AS evidence, a.record_id AS resource_id, a.content AS old_value, b.content AS new_value, b.observed_at AS seen_at
FROM dns_record a
JOIN dns_record b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.record_id = a.record_id AND b.observed_at > a.observed_at AND b.content <> a.content
WHERE a.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND a.name = 'host-524b42.quest' AND b.name = 'host-524b42.quest'
  AND a.observed_at >= '2026-04-16T21:11:15.232Z' AND b.observed_at <= '2026-10-24T07:58:55.125Z'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dns_record m WHERE m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND m.record_id = a.record_id AND m.observed_at > a.observed_at AND m.observed_at < b.observed_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'audit_event' AS evidence, e.resource_id, e.old_value, e.new_value, e.occurred_at AS seen_at
FROM audit_event e
WHERE e.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND e.occurred_at >= '2026-04-16T21:11:15.232Z' AND e.occurred_at <= '2026-10-24T07:58:55.125Z'
  AND e.resource_id IN (SELECT d.record_id FROM dns_record d WHERE d.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND d.name = 'host-524b42.quest')
ORDER BY seen_at, evidence, resource_id

Its window opens at 2026-03-20T01:29:03.000Z there and at 2026-04-16T21:11:15.232Z here: a survey finding's window starts where the bundle's audit log begins, or at its DNS run when the bundle holds no audit log.
